name: XlDataLabelPosition
description: Specifies where the data label is positioned.

constants.name: xlLabelPositionCenter
constants.description: Data label is centered on the data point or is inside a bar or pie chart.

constants.name: xlLabelPositionAbove
constants.description: Data label is positioned above the data point.

constants.name: xlLabelPositionBelow
constants.description: Data label is positioned below the data point.

constants.name: xlLabelPositionLeft
constants.description: Data label is positioned to the left of the data point.

constants.name: xlLabelPositionRight
constants.description: Data label is positioned to the right of the data point.

constants.name: xlLabelPositionOutsideEnd
constants.description: Data label is positioned outside the data point at the top edge.

constants.name: xlLabelPositionInsideEnd
constants.description: Data label is positioned inside the data point at the top edge.

constants.name: xlLabelPositionInsideBase
constants.description: Data label is positioned inside the data point at the bottom edge.

constants.name: xlLabelPositionBestFit
constants.description: Microsoft Office Excel 2007 sets the position of the data label.

constants.name: xlLabelPositionMixed
constants.description: Data labels are in multiple positions.

constants.name: xlLabelPositionCustom
constants.description: Data label is in a custom position.
